window.description: A half-open window kept in whole milliseconds; finer digits are dropped. A window longer than the max_time_window of a historical source is counted in parts of at most max_time_window; only a window that needs more than 24 parts is clipped to its newest parts, which the source report states.

until.description: Exclusive upper bound; not in the future.

window.title: SupportOperationsWindow

levels.description: Log levels to read; error and warn when absent.
levels.title: SupportOperationsLogLevels

page.description: Message groups per page, default 50, at most 200. A cursor carries the window of the first page; a follow-up request may omit window or must repeat it.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous answer of the same query.

page.title: SupportOperationsLogGroupPage

audit_reference.description: Unverified ticket-like annotation recorded in the audit log only.
audit_reference.title: SupportHistoryAuditReference
